Rashi on Menachot 14a:10:1.english: To pour out the remainder - He would pour the remainder of the blood onto the western base of the outer altar.

Rashi on Menachot 14a:12:1.english: What is to be rendered piggul - What would one eat from that bull such that he would be liable to karet on account of piggul?

Rashi on Menachot 14a:12:2.hebrew: לאיפגולי דם - כלומר, דהאי דקתני פיגל, בדם קאמר: שאם יאכל מן הדם בשוגג, יתחייב ב' חטאות: אחת משום כרת דם, ואחת משום כרת דפיגול:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:12:2.english: To render the blood piggul - That is to say, that which [the baraita] teaches, "he rendered [it] piggul," it is speaking with regard to the blood: that if one eats from the blood unwittingly, he would be liable to two sin-offerings: one on account of the karet of blood, and one on account of the karet of piggul.

Rashi on Menachot 14a:12:3.hebrew: הקומץ והלבונה - דמנחת ישראל, והקטרת כו' – דכל הנך אין להם מתירין, שהם מתרין אחרים. וקיימא לן (לקמן מנחות דף יז.) דאין פיגול אלא בדבר שיש לו מתירין: או לאדם – כגון שירי מנחה שהקומץ מתירן, או למזבח – כגון אימורי בהמה שדם מתירן ליקרב; דגמרינן משלמים, דכתיב בהו עיקר פיגול: מה שלמים דבר שיש מתירין לאדם ולמזבח, שזריקת דם מתיר האימורין ליקרב והבשר ליאכל – אף כל דבר שיש לו מתירין או לאדם או למזבח, לאפוקי הנך דאין אחר מתירן. ואי קשיא: פשיטא דקומץ לא מיחייבי עליה כרת משום פיגול, דהא כי אכיל מיניה פקע ליה פיגוליה, שהרי לא קרב המתיר? תריץ: כגון שהוצת האור ברובו, דחשיב כמאן דקרב, כדאמרינן לקמן (מנחות דף כו:): "קומץ מאימתי מתיר שיריים באכילה? משהוצת האור ברובו" – דלא חשיב כבשר אלא כשירי הדם:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:12:3.english: The handful and the frankincense - [That is, the handful and frankincense] of an Israelite's meal offering; and "the incense," etc. For all of these have no permitting factors [that permit them], as they permit other [items]. And we hold (below, Menachot 17a) that [the law of] piggul applies only to something that has permitting factors: either for man, such as the remainder of a meal offering, which the handful permits [for eating], or for the Altar, such as the sacrificial parts [eimurin] of an animal, which the blood permits to be offered [on the Altar fire]; for we derive [this] from peace offerings, regarding which the primary [passage of] piggul is written: just as a peace offering is something that has permitting factors [both] for man and for the Altar—as the sprinkling of the blood permits the sacrificial parts to be offered and the meat to be eaten—so too, anything that has permitting factors, either for man or for the Altar [can become piggul], to the exclusion of these [items], which no other [item or act] permits. And if you ask: Isn't it obvious that one is not liable to karet on account of piggul for [eating] the handful, since when one eats from it, its piggul status lapses, as the permitting factor was not offered [on the Altar]? Resolve it: [For instance,] where the fire has caught on most of it, such that it is considered as though it were [already] offered, as we say later (Menachot 26b): "From when does the handful permit the remainder for consumption? Once the fire has caught on most of it"—for [the unburned remainder of the handful] is not considered like [sacrificial] meat, but rather like the remnants of the blood.

Rashi on Menachot 14a:15:1.hebrew: לאיפגולי מאי - כלומר, מי יתפגל במחשבה זו, שיהיו חייבין כרת באכילתו:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:15:1.english: What is to be rendered piggul - That is to say, what will be rendered piggul through this intention, such that one would be liable to karet for eating it?

Rashi on Menachot 14a:1:1.hebrew: אלא אי אמרת - גבי יריכות, דמחד גופא אתו, תרי גופי נינהו, ואם פיגל זו בלא זו לא נתפגלה זו; גבי חלות, כי ערבן לאכול כזית משתיהן, מי מיצטרפי? מי מהניא עירוב מחשבתו למיהוי חד גופא טפי מחיבור זבח, דלא מהני להו לירצות:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:1:1.english: But if you say - With regard to the thighs, which come from a single body, [you say that] they are [considered] two bodies, and if he rendered this one piggul without that one, that [other] one did not become piggul; [then] with regard to the loaves, when he combined them [in his intent] to eat an olive-bulk from both of them, would they combine? Would the combination of his thought avail to make [the loaves] a single body, more than the physical connection of the sacrifice, which does not avail for them [the thighs] to be accepted?

Rashi on Menachot 14a:2:1.hebrew: רבי היא - ור' יוסי לא איירי בהו, ולא תקשי לרב הונא:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:2:1.english: It is Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] - And Rabbi Yosei did not speak about them, so it does not pose a difficulty to Rav Huna.

Rashi on Menachot 14a:2:2.english: To eat half an olive-bulk from this loaf - [Namely,] tomorrow.

Rashi on Menachot 14a:2:3.hebrew: שזה כשר - להקטיר אימוריו ולאכול בשר, דהא לא חישב אלא חצי אכילה בחצי מתיר:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:2:3.english: That this is valid - [It is valid] to burn its sacrificial portions and to eat [its] meat, as he had intent only regarding half an [olive-bulk of] consumption during half of the permitting agent.

Rashi on Menachot 14a:3:1.hebrew: אבל אמר כזית משתיהן - דערבן לחלות במחשבתו, ואמר בכל אחד ואחד מן הכבשים: הריני שוחט ע"מ לאכול כזית משתיהן [למחר] — מצטרפי:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:3:1.english: But if he said an olive-bulk from both of them - For he combined the loaves in his thought, and said during each and every one of the lambs: "I am hereby slaughtering on condition to consume an olive-bulk from both of them [tomorrow]" — they combine.

Rashi on Menachot 14a:4:1.hebrew: ורבי אליבא דמאן אמרה - להא מתניתין דקתני לעיל: לעולם אינו חייב עד שיפגל בשתיהן בכזית, בשתיהן אין, באחד מהן לא:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:4:1.english: And Rabbi, in accordance with whose opinion did he say it - [Namely,] this teaching that was taught above: "One is never liable unless he has intent of piggul with regard to both of them with an olive-bulk" — with regard to both of them, yes; with regard to one of them, no.

Rashi on Menachot 14a:4:2.english: Rather, he stated it in accordance with Rabbi Yosei - And it teaches that the loaves combine.

Rashi on Menachot 14a:4:3.hebrew: והדרא קושיין לדוכתא - דאי אמרת בשלמא יריכות חד גופא הוא כו', כדאמרינן לעיל (מנחות דף יג:):
Rashi on Menachot 14a:4:3.english: And our difficulty returns to its place - For [the question was]: "Granted, if you say that the thighs are one body, etc.," as we said above (Menachot 13b).

Rashi on Menachot 14a:5:1.hebrew: לעולם אליבא דרבנן - ודקשיא לך: אפי' באחת מהן נמי — לא תימא בשתיהן, דהא ודאי אפילו באחת מהן נמי:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:5:1.english: Actually, in accordance with the Rabbis - And [as for] that which was difficult to you: "Even with one of them as well [it should be piggul]?" — do not say "with both of them" [referring to the loaves], for indeed, certainly even with one of them as well [it is piggul].

Rashi on Menachot 14a:5:2.hebrew: אלא אימא עד שיפגל בשניהם - הכבשים, ואפילו בכזית, דשחט ב' כבשים ע"מ לאכול כזית מחלה אחת או מב' חלות. אבל אם חישב בכבש אחד לאכול כזית אחד מן החלות, ובשחיטת האחר לא חישב – לא הוי פיגול, דאין מפגלין בעבודת חצי מתיר:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:5:2.english: Rather, say: Until he renders [them] piggul with both of them - [Meaning,] the lambs. And [it becomes piggul] even with an olive-bulk, where he slaughtered two lambs with the intention to eat an olive-bulk from one loaf or from two loaves. But if he had [improper] intent during [the slaughter of] one lamb to eat one olive-bulk from the loaves, and during the slaughter of the other he did not have [such] intent, it is not piggul, for one does not render [an offering] piggul through the service of half a permitting factor.

Rashi on Menachot 14a:6:1.hebrew: ולאפוקי מדר"מ - דאמר בסוף מתני' מפגלין בעבודת חצי מתיר, דקתני: שחט אחד מן הכבשים לאכול שתי חלות למחר, ר"מ אומר: פיגול, וחייבין עליו כרת. ואי קשיא: הקומץ את המנחה אמאי פוסל במחשבתו? הא עבודת חצי מתיר הוא, דהאיכא נמי לבונה! תריץ: בקמיצה ודאי עבודה שלימה היא, דהא ליכא קמיצה בלבונה. תדע, דהא בהקטרת קומץ, אם חישב לאכול שירים למחר, פליגי רבנן ואמרי: כיון דאיכא נמי הקטרת לבונה, לא חשיבא הקטרת קומץ לפגל, דקתני מתניתין: פיגל בהקטרת קומץ ולא בלבונה כו' (דף יג.), וחכ"א: אין פיגול עד שיפגל בכל המתיר. ואי קשיא: הא אוקימנא בריש פירקין (שם) לכ"ע מפגלין בחצי מתיר, דקתני: הקומץ ע"מ להקטיר קומצה למחר מודה ר' יוסי כו', והרי לא חישב אלא על חצי מתיר, על הקטרת קומץ? לאו פירכא היא, דלא דמי להאי דהכא: דהתם חישב על חצי מתיר בשעת עבודה שלימה, והאי חישב בשעת חצי עבודה, כגון שחיטת אחד מן הכבשים:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:6:1.english: And to exclude [the view] of Rabbi Meir - Who said at the end of our mishna that one renders [an offering] piggul through the service of half a permitting factor, as it teaches: [If] one slaughtered one of the sheep to eat two loaves tomorrow, Rabbi Meir says: It is piggul, and one is liable to karet for it. And if it is difficult: Why does one who removes the handful from the meal-offering disqualify [it] through his intention? Isn't it the service of half a permitting factor, since there is also frankincense? Resolve [it]: Regarding the removal of the handful, it is certainly a complete service, as there is no removal of a handful for frankincense. Know [that this is so], for regarding the burning of the handful, if he intended to eat the remnants tomorrow, the Rabbis disagree and say: Since there is also the burning of the frankincense, the burning of the handful is not considered [significant enough] to effect piggul; as our mishna teaches: [If] he effected piggul during the burning of the handful and not during [the burning of] the frankincense, etc. (page 13a), and the Sages say: There is no piggul until he effects piggul in the entire permitting factor. And if it is difficult: Didn't we establish at the beginning of our chapter (ibid.) that according to all [opinions], one can effect piggul with half a permitting factor, as it teaches: "[If] one removes the handful with the intention to burn its handful tomorrow, Rabbi Yose concedes, etc.," and yet he only intended regarding half a permitting factor—regarding the burning of the handful?! This is no refutation, for it is not comparable to this [case] here: for there, he intended concerning half a permitting factor at the time of a complete service, whereas here, he intended at the time of half a service, such as the slaughter of one of the sheep.

Rashi on Menachot 14a:7:1.english: In all cases - It implies that it excludes many things.

Rashi on Menachot 14a:7:2.hebrew: ורבי יוסי היא - דאמר במתניתין: בשתיהן אין, אבל באחת לא מפגלה חבירתה:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:7:2.english: And it is Rabbi Yosei - As he said in the mishna: [With regard to] both of them, yes, but [with regard to] one, it does not render its counterpart piggul.

Rashi on Menachot 14a:7:3.hebrew: ולאפוקי מדר"מ - דאמר מפגלין בעבודת חצי מתיר. מדקאמר הכא ובשניהן, היינו דקאמר ולעולם, דמשמע אפילו פיגל אף בשתיהן:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:7:3.english: And to exclude [the opinion] of Rabbi Meir - Who says that one renders [an offering] piggul through the service of half a permitting factor. Since [the baraita] states here, "and with both of them" [the lambs], that is why it states, "And never," which implies that even if he had piggul intent regarding both of them [the loaves] as well, [it is never piggul unless he also has intent with both lambs].

Rashi on Menachot 14a:7:4.hebrew: ולאפוקי נמי מדרבנן - דאמרי במתניתין: פיגל באחת נתפגלה חבירתה. (מדקתני הכא ובשתיהן) היינו דקאמר לעולם, דמשמע: לעולם, אפי' פיגל בשניהן, אין פיגול עד שיפגל אף בשתיהן:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:7:4.english: And to also exclude [the opinion of] the Rabbis - Who say in the mishna: [If] one had piggul intent regarding one [loaf], its counterpart has become piggul. (Since [the baraita] teaches here, "and with both of them" [the loaves]), that is why it states, "Never," which implies: "Never" — even if he had piggul intent with both of them [the lambs], there is no piggul until he also has piggul intent with both of them [the loaves] as well.

Rashi on Menachot 14a:9:1.hebrew: פיגל בדבר הנעשה בחוץ כו' - גבי פרים הנשרפים ושעירים הנשרפים כתיבי בתורת כהנים בפרשת פיגול בצו את אהרן, להזות מדמו על הפרוכת, הקטרת אימורין על מזבח החיצון:
Rashi on Menachot 14a:9:1.english: [If] he rendered [it] piggul with regard to a matter performed outside, etc. - Regarding the bulls that are burned and the he-goats that are burned, [this] is written in Torat Kohanim in the section on piggul in [Parashat] Tzav et Aharon: [namely, the inner rite is] to sprinkle of its blood upon the curtain, [and the outer rite is] the burning of the sacrificial portions on the outer altar.

Tosafot on Menachot 14a:12:1.hebrew: הקומץ והלבונה - הקשה בקונט': פשיטא דקומץ לא מיחייב עליה כרת משום פיגול, דהא אי אכיל מיניה, פקע ליה פיגוליה, שהרי לא קרב המתיר. ותירץ: כגון שהוצת האור ברובו, דחשיב כמאן דקרב, כדאמר לקמן (מנחות דף כו:): מאימתי מתיר שיריים באכילה? משהוצת האור ברובו. וקשה לפי': דאי הוצת האור ברובו, פקע פיגול ממנו; ואפי' פלגיה מחית אארעא, ופלגא אסקי' למערכה ומשלה בו האור - מסקינן ליה לכתחלה, כדאמר בסוף פרק ב"ש (זבחים דף מג:):
Tosafot on Menachot 14a:12:1.english: The handful and the frankincense - In the Kuntres, [Rashi] raised a difficulty: It is obvious that one is not liable to karet for [eating] the handful on account of piggul, for if one eats from it, its piggul status lapses, since the permitting factor was not offered. And he answered: [It is referring to a case] such as where the fire has caught on most of it, which is considered as though it was offered, as [the Gemara] says below (Menachot 26b): "From when does [the handful] permit the remainder to be eaten? Once the fire has caught on most of it." And [this] is difficult according to his explanation: For if the fire has caught on most of it, [the prohibition of] piggul has departed from it; and even [if] half of it was lying on the ground and half of it he brought up to the pyre and the fire took hold of it, we bring it [all] up [to the altar] ab initio, as [the Gemara] says at the end of chapter Beit Shammai (Zevachim 43b).

Tosafot on Menachot 14a:12:2.hebrew: והלבונה - בפרק ב"ש (גם זה שם.) מפרש, משום דאין להם מתירין לאדם ולא למזבח. וא"ת: והרי קומץ מתירה? ואע"פ שיכול להקטירה קודם קומץ, כדמוכח לעיל (מנחות דף יג:), קודם הקמיצה מיהא אין להקטירה! וי"ל, דמ"מ לא הויא לבונה דומיא דשלמים, דלבונה היא גופה מתיר, שמתרת שירים באכילה, ועיקר פיגול ילפינן משלמים. ואע"ג דשייך פיגול באימורים, דכמה דלא מקטרי אימורים כהנים בשר לא מצו אכלי — מ"מ לא חשיבי מתיר, כיון דאם נטמאו או נאבדו שרי בשר באכילה. ועי"ל, דלבונה אין לה מתיר בעבודת מזבח, ולא הויא דומיא דשלמים שעבודת מזבח מתירן, כגון זריקת דם:
Tosafot on Menachot 14a:12:2.english: And the frankincense - In chapter Beit Shammai (this too is there [Zevachim 43a]), [the Gemara] explains [that it is] because they have no permitting factors, neither for man nor for the altar. And if you say: But doesn't the handful permit it? And even though one may burn it before [burning] the handful, as is proven above (Menachot 13b), at any rate prior to the taking of the handful (kemitzah) it may not be burned! And one can say that nevertheless, frankincense is not comparable to peace offerings (shelamim); for frankincense is itself a permitting factor (matir), as it permits the remainder [of the meal offering] for consumption, and the primary [halakha of] piggul is derived from peace offerings. And even though piggul applies to sacrificial portions (eimorim) — for as long as the sacrificial portions are not burned, the priests may not eat the meat — nevertheless, they are not considered a permitting factor, since if they became ritually impure or were lost, the meat is permitted for consumption. And further, one can say that frankincense has no permitting factor through an altar service, and thus it is not comparable to peace offerings, which an altar service permits, such as the sprinkling of the blood.

Tosafot on Menachot 14a:12:3.hebrew: מנחת נסכים - בפ' ב"ש (ג"ז שם.), פי' הקונטרס דלא גרס מנחת נסכים, משום דפליגי בה בסיפא דהך משנה; (דבשר והדם) קתני: והנסכים הבאים בפני עצמן, דברי ר"מ, וחכ"א: אף בבאין עם הבהמה. ובפני עצמן דקאמר, היינו בין במתנדב נסכים, כדאמרינן: מתנדב אדם מנחת נסכים בכל יום, בין בבאין עם הבהמה, כגון שהביא זבחו היום ונסכיו מכאן עד י' ימים. ומיהו יש ליישב הגירסא: דמנחת נסכים מיירי במתנדב מנחת נסכים בכל יום, ונסכין הבאין בפני עצמן מיירי במביא זבחו היום ונסכיו מכאן עד י' ימים. אבל קשה, שלא היה לו להפסיק בדם, והכי ה"ל למיתני: והדם, ומנחת נסכים, ונסכים הבאין בפני עצמן. ושמא איידי דתנא מנחת כהנים ומנחת כהן משיח, תנא מיד מנחת נסכים:
Tosafot on Menachot 14a:12:3.english: The meal offering of libations - In chapter "Beit Shammai" (also there [Zevachim 43a]), Rashi explained that one should not include the reading "the meal offering of libations", because they disagree about it in the latter clause of this mishna; (that [after] "and the blood") it teaches: "And the libations that come by themselves, the statement of Rabbi Meir; and the Sages say: Even those that come with an animal." And when it says "by themselves", that means: whether in the case of one who voluntarily offers libations — as we say: "A person may voluntarily offer a meal offering of libations every day" — or whether in the case of those that come with an animal, such as where he brought his sacrifice today and his libations from now until ten days [later]. Nevertheless, the reading can be upheld: for "the meal offering of libations" [in the first clause] deals with one who voluntarily offers a meal offering of libations every day, whereas "the libations that come by themselves" [in the latter clause] deals with one who brings his sacrifice today and his libations from now until ten days [later]. But it is difficult [according to this], for [the Tanna] should not have interrupted with [the mention of] the blood; rather, he ought to have taught: "and the blood, and the meal offering of libations, and the libations that come by themselves". And perhaps since he taught "the meal offering of priests" and "the meal offering of the anointed priest", he immediately taught "the meal offering of libations".

Tosafot on Menachot 14a:9:1.hebrew: פיגל בדבר הנעשה בפנים לא פיגל - הא דא"ר יוסי גופיה בפרק הנזקין (גיטין נד: ושם), כה"ג ביוה"כ יוכיח דכי אמר פיגול מהימן, לאו דוקא, אלא פסול. וכי האי גוונא בפ"ק דזבחים (דף יד. ושם), גמרא ר"ש מכשר בהילוך, דאמר ר"ש בן לקיש: מודה ר"ש בהולכת חטאות הפנימיות כו', ופריך: והאמר ר"ש כל שאינו על מזבח החיצון כו', ומשני: מודה היה ר"ש לפסול מק"ו כו':
Tosafot on Menachot 14a:9:1.english: [If] he had intent of piggul regarding a matter performed inside, he did not render [it] piggul - That which Rabbi Yosei himself said in Perek HaNizakin (Gittin 54b and there), "Let the High Priest on Yom Kippur prove [it], for when he says [it is] piggul, he is believed" — [this is] not precise; rather, [it means that it is] disqualified (pasul). And similarly, in the first chapter of Zevachim (page 14a and there), in the Gemara [on the mishna], "Rabbi Shimon deems [it] valid during conveying," where Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish said: "Rabbi Shimon concedes regarding the conveying of the inner sin offerings, etc.," and [the Gemara] objects: "But didn't Rabbi Shimon say: Any [offering whose blood is] not on the external altar, etc.?" and answers: "Rabbi Shimon conceded to disqualify [it] through an *a fortiori* argument (kal va-chomer), etc."
